assessments.reasoning: The HTTPS acquisition at the 1.2 path has the claim's publisher digest and heading “LPPL Version 1.2  1999-09-03”.
Four contiguous ranges cover the 61,509-byte SPDX detail. Part 3 identifies “LaTeX Project Public License v1.2”, licenseId LPPL-1.2, and the HTTP edition URL in crossRef and seeAlso.
The repository API's unsigned v3.29.0 tag object points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the immutable revision used for the 1.2 detail.

challenge.method: Checked identifier, release target, and edition citation independently of the sample header. Compared section boundaries in SPDX licenseText with the publisher plaintext.
challenge.results: Both citation fields select the 1.2 path. The generic example URL does not. SPDX licenseText reads “Noting Exceptional Files If The Program contains” where the publisher places “Noting Exceptional Files” on its own line before the paragraph. The difference and crossRef match value “false” are consistent with the narrow claim.

limitations: The HTTP citation and HTTPS acquisition are distinct. The records establish edition correspondence only. Legal or byte equivalence, work-specific application, and redistribution rights fall outside that finding.
